synthesis:draft.headline: Newest AEMO POE50 operational-demand forecast for TAS1 interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1062.0 MW (run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608060830_20260806080130).
summary: The forecast run available as-of 2026-08-06T01:00:00Z was PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608060830_20260806080130 and its POE50 for target_end_local "2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" was 1062.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0532).
The same run reported POE10 = 1093.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0533) and POE90 = 1032.0 MW (evidence_id: ev0534) for that interval.

Compare_forecast_actual returned a mean absolute error (MAE) 5.5 MW for the paired targets it could compare (evidence_id: ev0597); however no actual operational demand was provably public by the as-of time for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z so the forecast cannot yet be compared to an as-of actual for that interval.

Contemporaneous Hobart-weather evidence as-of 2026-08-06T01:00:00Z is not available to this review (retrospective weather was excluded), so I have no weather observation that would indicate whether demand was expected to run higher at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
